# Bbcode

- [BBCode: how](plan.md) - The CMS's formatter renders BBCode on the server, the components package holds the editor and its reader and writer, and the CMS and housekeeping put the editor on their BBCode fields.
- [BBCode](spec.md) - One formatter turns the BBCode of news, forum posts, home notes and the settings' boxes into HTML, and one editor shows it as it will look while it is written.
